## Overview

ExperienceLink is a modern, responsive web platform that connects students with companies through short-term, real-world project opportunities. It allows students to gain career-relevant experience and build portfolios for future internships while helping companies complete small projects and discover potential talent.

**The primary purpose of this app is to:**

- Bridge the gap between students seeking experience and companies needing project help
- Provide a structured platform for skills-based matching and project management
- Enable students to build portfolios and gain real-world experience

## Product Requirements Document

### Background / Context

**Problem:** Many students struggle to get relevant career experience because most internships require prior experience — creating a "catch-22." At the same time, companies have small, real-world tasks that could be done by skilled students but lack a simple way to connect with them.

**Opportunity:** ExperienceLink bridges this gap by providing a structured platform for companies to post short-term projects and for students to gain practical experience, develop skills, and enhance their resumes.

### Objectives & Success Metrics

| Objective | Metric | Target |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| Help students gain experience | Projects completed | 100+ in first 3 months |
| Increase student engagement | Monthly retention | 60% active accounts |
| Attract company participation | Registered companies | 50+ in first quarter |
| Deliver smooth UX | Page load time | <2 seconds |

### User Stories

**For Students:**

- As a student, I want to browse projects so I can find opportunities that match my skills
- As a student, I want to apply to a project so I can gain experience
- As a student, I want to upload completed work so companies can evaluate it
- As a student, I want to build a profile showing my skills and completed projects

**For Companies:**

- As a company, I want to post new projects so students can apply
- As a company, I want to review applicants and view their profiles
- As a company, I want to leave feedback on student work

### Non-Functional Requirements

| Category | Requirement |
|----------|-------------|
| Performance | Pages load within 2 seconds |
| Responsiveness | Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile |
| Accessibility | Follows WCAG 2.1 AA standards |
| Security | Firebase Auth for secure login |
| Scalability | Structured for easy database migration |
